io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.installer

Class AddonCatalog

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.installer.AddonCatalog

  • public final class AddonCatalog
extends java.lang.Object
    The source of truth for everything the in-game installer can install: Slimefun core plus every known Slimefun5 addon. Populated from AddonManifest.loadBundled().
